procedurePlan.heading: How to run Escaped defect severity weighting
steps: Read seed-skills/jira-qa-workflows/SKILL.md and seed-skills/risk-based-testing/SKILL.md and packages/web/src/app/blog/posts/qa-metrics-kpis-dashboard-guide.ts and docs/product/SKILLS-GAP-RESEARCH-2026-07.md and record the supported workflow, inputs, outputs, and cleanup responsibilities.
Create an isolated positive baseline for Escaped defect severity weighting with deterministic data and one named owner.
Run the baseline first and capture exact values, state transitions, event order, and safe diagnostic evidence.

Inject one failure at a time for Escaped defect severity weighting example, Escaped defect severity weighting test cases, Escaped defect severity weighting failure modes, keeping every unrelated input fixed.
Compare the first differing state with the scenario matrix, classify the fault, and reject weak success-only evidence.
Run the gate in CI, retain only safe artifacts, clean temporary state, and link the failure to its repository evidence.
